aboutGame.title: What is Bunker Tidy Up?
paragraphs: Bunker Tidy Up is a relaxing first-person organization simulation for PC. You spawn into a post-apocalyptic shelter packed with 17,437 scattered supplies and sort them one at a time onto the shelves, crates, and containers where the game says they belong. There are no timers, no combat, and no fail state, just a very large pile and a lot of storage to fill.

With more than 100 unique item types across food, drinks, medicine, tools, books, and survival gear, progress comes from category recognition and route planning rather than speed. Upgrades such as Hand Capacity, Shelf Scatter, and Item Pull shorten every run, while 14 Steam achievements and a 100 percent clear give completionists a long-term goal.

highlights.detail: Survey the room before you touch anything and note which supply groups appear most often

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Bunker Tidy Up.

items.question: What is Bunker Tidy Up?
items.answer: Bunker Tidy Up is a relaxing first-person organization simulation for PC. You sort 17,437 scattered supplies onto shelves and into containers inside a post-apocalyptic bunker, with no timers, combat, or fail states.

items.question: How many items are in Bunker Tidy Up?
items.answer: The bunker starts with 17,437 individual supplies spread across more than 100 unique item types, grouped into food, drinks, medicine, tools, books, hygiene, pet care, and survival gear.

items.question: Is Bunker Tidy Up hard?
items.answer: No. Bunker Tidy Up is built to be relaxing: there are no timers or score penalties, and the challenge comes from category recognition and route planning rather than reflexes.

items.question: What should I upgrade first in Bunker Tidy Up?
items.answer: Start with Hand Capacity to carry more per trip, then add Shelf Scatter and Item Pull to speed up sorting. Movement speed and cosmetics can wait until the core upgrades are online.

items.question: Does Bunker Tidy Up have codes or multiplayer?
items.answer: No. Bunker Tidy Up is a single-player PC game with no redeem codes and no multiplayer mode, and save-anytime support means you can stop whenever you like.

items.question: How many achievements does Bunker Tidy Up have?
items.answer: Bunker Tidy Up includes 14 Steam achievements, which add optional structure for players chasing a full 100 percent clear.
